_comment: Phase 4 economy swap: the old recycler/ammo-maker/component-maker/junk factory is RETIRED — production is the process lines (process.json). What remains here are BAY MODULES carried on the scrapbot: weapons (fire in combat, fed chain-made ammo), the Ammo Loader (fire-rate), and the Phase-5 support modules (tactical abilities). 'bay':true = a shaped loadout piece (no in/out ports). 'cost' is paid in base chain products when crafted/built.

copper_weapon.name: Copper Blaster
copper_weapon._note: A BAY module (just a shape — no in/out ports). Draws from the bot's loaded ammo (a chain product now). See PlayerCombat / FactoryGrid.weapon_stats.

plastic_weapon.name: Resin Repeater
plastic_weapon._note: Spread: one trigger-pull fires 3 pellets in a fan (spread_deg).

ceramic_weapon.name: Ceramic Lance
ceramic_weapon._note: Pierce: the shot passes through up to 2 enemies (hits 3 in a line).

ammo_loader.name: Ammo Loader
ammo_loader._note: A BAY module (shape only, no ports). Each one speeds up every weapon's fire rate by its fire_rate (see FactoryGrid.fire_rate_multiplier). Stack them for faster shooting.

coolant_module.name: Coolant Vent
coolant_module._note: Phase 5 SUPPORT module: an 'ability' {id,name,glyph,amount?,charges,field_only} grants a tactical, non-twitch power used from the Scrapbot menu ([1]-[3]). Charges are per-run (refilled at the lair); stacking the same module sums charges. See RunState.installed_abilities / ScrapbotPanel. Craftable at the Fabricator / found in the field.
